reasons: Cited Sections 18.1–18.2 satisfy every element of the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, coverage through term plus one year, and certificates on request.
Obligations run against Vendor (counterparty) and benefit Customer; Section 18.2 expressly states insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, so it does not undercut the liability regime.

Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and none is needed; the rendered text is unchanged from the original and the deterministic insurance-presence check passes.
